groupsReleased.description: The releases (sourcing decisions) of the day.

inRegionShare.description: Releases in the destination's region / releases with both regions known; null when none is known.

unknownRegionCount.description: Releases whose node or destination region is unknown.

meanLegs.description: The mean departures after the pickup per release; null without a release.

reassignmentRate.description: Releases with releaseNo > 1 / groupsReleased; null without a release.

400.description: invalid-report-range. from or to is not a date (YYYY-MM-DD), from is after to, or the range exceeds 366 days.

type.description: Problem type URI: the base https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/ followed by the slug, for example https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/assignment-locked.

500.description: internal-error, an unexpected failure (the detail never carries the internal message).

type.description: Problem type URI: the base https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/ followed by the slug, for example https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/assignment-locked.
